💡 athena-crisis | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Developing and contributing to the core engine and mechanics of a turn-based tactical strategy game.
✨ Key Features: • Open core technology for game development • Modular package structure (athena, apollo, hera, ui, etc.) • TypeScript and React based • Node.js and pnpm for setup • Documentation and Playground site
📖 Summary: Athena Crisis is an open-core, turn-based tactical strategy game developed using TypeScript and React. The repository provides the core engine and tools for game development, allowing developers to contribute to or build upon the game's mechanics, while the full game content remains proprietary.
